tools.name: studio-add-column
tools.description:
Creates a migration file that adds a new column to an existing table.
Use when your table needs a new field without recreating the table.
Needs: Target table id (schema.table), Column name and column type
Produces: New SQL migration file in supabase/migrations
Audience: backend-dev
Modes: assisted, loose

tools.name: studio-add-constraint
tools.description:
Creates a migration that adds foreign key, unique, or check constraints to a table.
Use when enforcing stronger data integrity rules in existing tables.
Needs: Target table id, Constraint type, Constraint details
Produces: New SQL migration file with ALTER TABLE ... ADD CONSTRAINT
Audience: backend-dev
Modes: assisted, loose

tools.name: studio-add-function
tools.description:
Generates a migration that creates or replaces a SQL/PLpgSQL function.
Use when adding reusable database logic or backend calculations.
Needs: Function name, Return type, Function body
Produces: New SQL migration file with CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION
Audience: backend-dev
Modes: assisted, loose

tools.name: studio-add-index
tools.description:
Creates a migration that adds an index to speed up query performance.
Use when queries on one or more columns become slow.
Needs: Target table id, Indexed columns
Produces: New SQL migration file with CREATE INDEX
Audience: backend-dev
Modes: assisted, loose

tools.name: studio-add-rls-policy
tools.description:
Generates a migration that adds a Row Level Security policy to a table.
Use when controlling who can read or write rows in a protected table.
Needs: Target table id, Policy command, Allowed roles
Produces: New SQL migration file with CREATE POLICY
Audience: backend-dev
Modes: managed, assisted

tools.name: studio-create-rpc
tools.description:
Creates a public RPC function migration so PostgREST can expose it as an API endpoint.
Use when frontend/backend needs a custom database action exposed as RPC.
Needs: RPC function name, Return type, Function body
Produces: New SQL migration file for a public RPC function
Audience: backend-dev
Modes: assisted, loose

tools.name: studio-create-table
tools.description:
Builds a migration that creates a new table, columns, and optional RLS enablement.
Use when introducing a brand new table in your schema.
Needs: Table name, Column definitions
Produces: New SQL migration file with CREATE TABLE
Audience: backend-dev
Modes: assisted, loose

tools.name: studio-create-view
tools.description:
Generates a migration that creates or replaces a SQL view.
Use when you want a reusable read model built from one or more tables.
Needs: View name, SELECT query
Produces: New SQL migration file with CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW
Audience: backend-dev
Modes: assisted, loose

tools.name: studio-endpoint-map
tools.description:
Builds endpoint declarations from the intent graph for tables and RPC functions.
Use after intent graph updates to refresh expected API surface.
Needs: studio.intent.graph artifact
Produces: Updated endpoints inside studio.intent.graph
Audience: mixed
Modes: managed, assisted

tools.name: studio-greenfield-init
tools.description:
Creates an empty project intent graph so you can design schema before any live database exists.
Use at project start when building database structure from scratch.
Needs: No existing artifacts required
Produces: studio.intent.graph artifact in greenfield mode
Audience: mixed
Modes: assisted, loose

tools.name: studio-intent-init
tools.description:
Builds the intent graph using confidence output from intent sync.
Runs as the final stage of adoption to produce the working graph.
Needs: studio.intent.sync-report artifact
Produces: studio.intent.graph artifact
Audience: backend-dev
Modes: managed

tools.name: studio-intent-patch
tools.description:
Updates one entity's managed status in the intent graph.
Use when adoption confidence needs manual override or an entity should be excluded.
Needs: Entity id, Patch action
Produces: Updated studio.intent.graph artifact
Audience: mixed
Modes: managed, assisted

tools.name: studio-intent-sync
tools.description:
Compares live schema snapshot with parsed SQL intent and calculates confidence scores.
Runs during adoption workflow between parse and intent graph initialization.
Needs: studio.schema.snapshot artifact, studio.sql.ast artifact
Produces: studio.intent.sync-report artifact
Audience: backend-dev
Modes: managed

tools.name: studio-introspect
tools.description:
Scans your live database and stores a snapshot of tables, policies, and extensions.
Use this before adoption, planning, or validation so tools work with current database state.
Needs: Database connection configured in supabase-tools config
Produces: studio.schema.snapshot artifact
Audience: backend-dev
Modes: assisted, loose

tools.name: studio-lint
tools.description:
Scans migration SQL for risky patterns and naming/safety issues.
Run before applying migrations to reduce operational risk.
Needs: studio.sql.ast artifact
Produces: studio.migration.lint artifact
Audience: backend-dev
Modes: managed, assisted, loose

tools.name: studio-migration-plan
tools.description:
Compares intent graph against schema snapshot and lists required changes.
Use when preparing migration rollout and impact review.
Needs: studio.intent.graph artifact, studio.schema.snapshot artifact
Produces: studio.migration.plan artifact
Audience: backend-dev
Modes: managed, assisted

tools.name: studio-release-gate
tools.description:
Combines lint and validation evidence into a release pass/fail decision.
Run right before applying migrations, especially in production workflows.
Needs: Validation artifacts such as rls-check, rpc-lint, migration-lint
Produces: studio.release.gate artifact
Audience: mixed
Modes: managed, assisted

tools.name: studio-rls-check
tools.description:
Checks managed tables for missing Row Level Security command coverage.
Run before release to catch data-access policy gaps.
Needs: studio.intent.graph artifact
Produces: studio.rls.report, studio.rls.plan artifacts
Audience: backend-dev
Modes: managed, assisted

tools.name: studio-rpc-lint
tools.description:
Reviews functions and RPC definitions for common security weaknesses.
Run before release to catch risky security-definer and search_path issues.
Needs: studio.intent.graph artifact
Produces: studio.rpc.plan artifact
Audience: backend-dev
Modes: managed, assisted

tools.name: studio-sql-parse
tools.description:
Reads migration SQL files and extracts structured statements for analysis.
Run this before linting, planning, or adoption comparisons.
Needs: Migration files in supabase/migrations
Produces: studio.sql.ast artifact
Audience: backend-dev
Modes: assisted, loose
